payload.text: LAKSA ON laksa-vc's GO, and not before (it is holding 0.1.9 until its QFM release run is OFF MIX and laksa-dc has gated it on 0.1.8). Then, in Laksa's tree: bin/devbin upgrade --from the machine install, TWICE (the first pass runs Laksa's 0.1.8 runtime and records the path again); stage exactly bin/devbin, bin/.devbin/lib and bin/.devbin/manifest.sha256 (expect 59: 58 updated plus LICENSE.md); commit with --only through Laksa's gate, never --no-verify, using the sweep's message, "devbin: vendored runtime to 0.1.9 (d7f2ed13)"; send laksa-vc the sha. laksa-dc then runs check all on 0.1.9. laksa-vc was told that no Laksa workspace was flagged: 0163 fires only where a cargo config names target-dir or include over an unreadable directory, below the root.
